Requirement: I01: Only the owner reducer changes document semantics.

I02: A callback publishes either one coherent snapshot or nothing. Failed transactions publish no document/history change or native text synchronization. Public and reentrant protocol reads observe only the last published snapshot. Working-state access is private to the reducer. Notification completion/rollback is explicit and never exposes abandoned staging.
I03: Unique IDs, valid schema, acyclic ancestry and a legal caret destination in every flow.
I04: Positions resolve at their revision; stale commands reject unless explicitly rebasable.
I05: Native UTF-16 operations preserve exact accepted units; code-point commands never use unit counts accidentally.
I06: Grapheme/layout changes never modify stored attribution.
I07: Within one attribution epoch, identical final candidate text gives identical attributes independent of intermediate candidates.
I08: Partial commit freezes committed attributes; later suffix cancellation cannot erase that prefix.
I09: Each adapter callback is accepted once by its stamp; lifecycle end alone never inserts event text.
I10: A closed connection epoch cannot mutate a newer connection.
I11: Geometry is returned only with its actual document/layout/font/viewport key.
I12: Undo/redo restore exact content, structural IDs, raw attribution and recorded selection.
I13: Input text projection and accepted native proposal agree within the declared admission scope.
I14: Durable acknowledgement follows durable storage; truncated/corrupt journal tails never become edits.
I15: A normal local edit never flattens or serializes the whole document.
I16: Formatting-only and net-no-op commands do not manufacture text replacements or input restarts.
I17: Platform rendering and accessibility act on the same semantic document revision.
